_doc: Studio-wide text for the Glowfin Games website. Edit, then run: python3 build.py
name: Glowfin Games
intro: Glowfin Games is a one-person indie studio in Ireland making small, bright games you can pick up with one hand and keep playing for months.
about: We make games that are easy to start and deep to master: clear rules, readable screens, and builds that let clever players break them wide open.
Every game is made to respect your time. No ads, no energy timers, no subscriptions. Try it for free, and pay once if you want the rest.

contact.text: Questions, bug reports, press or just saying hi: we read everything.

form._doc: Contact form, shown when both are set. endpoint = the contact Worker URL (worker/contact), turnstile_sitekey = the public Turnstile site key.
